svg.aria-label: Magnesium, page 2 of 3. Indication Treatment and prevention of hypomagnesemia, management of acute torsades de pointes (polymorphic ventricular tachycardia), control of seizures in eclampsia/preeclampsia, and adjunctive treatment of severe acute asthma exacerbations. Contraindication Myocardial damage, heart block, severe renal insufficiency (risk of hypermagnesemia toxicity), and hypermagnesemia. Adverse reaction Severe respiratory depression, profound hypotension, complete loss of deep tendon reflexes, and circulatory collapse. Side effects Flushing, sweating, transient hypotension, drowsiness, and local injection-site irritation.
